description.en: Marine Ovatiovermis-inspired bare soft tubular lobopodian: two long anterior filter-limb pairs rise from the trunk, four middle pairs are shorter, and three robust posterior pairs terminate in single curved supporting claws. Fine filtering setae are economical original simplifications. Static artistic posture, no armour, humanoid arms or exact feeding mechanics.
description.zh: 海生Ovatiovermis启发裸软管状叶足动物，前两对长滤食足举起，中四对较短，后三对粗足各具单强弯爪支撑；细滤毛经济原创简化。静态艺术姿势，无躯甲、人形手臂或精确取食力学承诺。

structural_scope.en: Marine bare tubular lobopodian with two very long anterior limb pairs, four shorter middle pairs and three robust posterior single-clawed pairs; economic filter setae. Static original pose, no armour or exact feeding mechanics claim.
